name: AntiVenom Hub
changelog: Fixed: The top-bar SETTINGS button now opens the AntiVenom menu (System Check, Real-Debrid, Send Problem Report) instead of Kodi's stock settings
Speed: Fixed Firestick cache read factor (was 2000x, now 10x) that pinned the CPU
Speed: Removed nonstop GPU redraw (nofliptimeout) so idle menus are smooth
Speed: Ambient auto-play trailers are now OFF by default (toggle in AntiVenom menu)
Fixed: Fire TV skin now self-repairs to match the latest build on every start (fixes stale/partial skin installs)
Fixed: 'Authorize Now' for Real-Debrid now shows the pairing code popup
New: Automatic crash reporting sends errors to the developer so they get fixed
New: Settings > 'Send Problem Report to Developer' for issues like black screens
Fixed: Kodi logging was switched off; it is now on (takes effect after a restart)
